data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1729 opened gross claims outstanding of GBP 131.621m at 1 January 2020. Analysis of the gross claims development table indicates a net prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 7.305m (c.5.6% of opening reserves), driven by adverse development in underwriting years 2017-2018 that outweighed favourable movement on older years. The report's narrative states an overall net surplus on prior year reserves of GBP 5.9m (net basis), which differs from the gross-triangle-derived movement; this JSON uses the gross claims development triangle as the primary source.
raw_causal_phrases: In 2020, there has been an overall surplus of GBP 5.9m on prior year reserves (2019: deficit GBP 1.8m).
Two key themes from 2019 continued throughout 2020 in our segment of the industry; 1) Natural catastrophe loss activity and 2) US Casualty reserve deterioration.
We continue to believe that the industry will see a deterioration of casualty results from previous accident years.
The directors consider that the provisions for gross claims and related reinsurance recoveries are fairly stated on the basis of the information currently available to them.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) is calculated from the gross claims development triangle (cumulative incurred data) on pages 37-38, excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2019 and 2020) per the instructions. The report's narrative states a net surplus of GBP 5.9m on prior year reserves (net of reinsurance) which differs from the gross-triangle-derived PYD of +GBP 7.305m; this JSON reports the gross-derived figure and notes the net narrative figure in exact_reserve_text. All amounts in the triangle and technical provisions were presented in GBP '000 in the report and have been converted to millions. Allocation of PYD to specific lines of business is not explicitly provided; LOB movements are inferred with low confidence.
